create_evalutil_instance: create an EvalUtil instance with a specified number of keypoints for network evaluation
feed_keypoint_data: feed ground truth, visibility, and predicted keypoints to EvalUtil to compute euclidean distances
get_evaluation_measures: get mean error, median error, AUC, and PCK curve measures across all keypoints
calc_auc_function: calculate the normalized area under the curve given x and y value arrays
get_pck_for_keypoint: get the PCK score for a single keypoint at a given error threshold
